title: Full-Year Supply Adjustment, Small Business Electricity Supply Grace-Period Renewal Rate
content:
Twelve billed cycles in a year mark a site that has been supplied the whole year round.

1. For a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed inside the grace period after rollover, the energy lines posted on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date are counted; 12 or more take 0.04 cents per kWh off the grace-period renewal rate; 6 to 11 take 0.02 cents off; fewer than 6 take nothing off.
2. Only the agreement's energy charge lines count; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

**Cases (hypothetical agreements)**

- A print shop billed every month for the past year shows 12 energy lines in the window: 0.04 cents per kWh off.
- A site supplied for the last 11 cycles only shows 11 energy lines: 0.02 cents off; with 6 lines it is still 0.02 cents off.
- A site that started supply five cycles ago shows 5 energy lines: nothing off.
